subject: txn: force locking temp index keys in dml in next-gen (#64398)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs first parent. The change forces pessimistic DMLs in next-gen builds to lock all temporary index keys via `session.KeyNeedToLock`, aligning with next-gen’s stricter conflict checking; call-chain impact is limited to the existing `LazyTxn.KeysNeedToLock` → executor pessimistic lock step. No remaining Blocker/High issues found in session transaction/locking semantics.
